verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships a built-in AI assistant, Breeze Assistant, which builds reports from plain-language requests. It also offers in-product AI agents for marketing, sales and service: agents that prospect automatically, plan campaigns from a single goal, and draft CRM updates and follow-ups for approval. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the assistant's task-delegation scope and controls (all evidence is marketing-page copy), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: with Breeze Assistant, describe the report you need in plain language, and HubSpot will build it from your actual data.
Build demand, win deals, and serve your customers with a team of AI agents for marketing, sales, and customer service.
Plan a full campaign from a single goal, in one session
Approve automatic CRM updates and follow-up drafts after every meeting
